headline: 川普拒伊朗荷姆茲提案
context: 美國總統川普拒絕了伊朗的最新提案——重新開放荷姆茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz），換取停火。川普表示，德黑蘭提出這個方案，只是因為戰局對伊朗不利。這份提案的內容，和今年六月美伊已經談成的備忘錄相近。

sources.name: Reuters
sources.summary: Trump rejects Iranian proposal to open Hormuz and end fighting Reuters
sources.title: Trump rejects Iranian proposal to open Hormuz and end fighting - Reuters

sources.name: Al Jazeera
sources.summary: US President Donald Trump has rejected Iran’s latest proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz to shipping.
sources.title: Trump rejects Iranian offer to reopen Strait of Hormuz

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: The US president says Tehran had only put forward the proposal because it is losing the war.
sources.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days

sources.name: NPR
sources.summary: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.
sources.title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'

thread_text:
美國總統川普拒絕了伊朗的最新提案——重新開放荷姆茲海峽，換取停火。川普表示，德黑蘭提出這個方案，只是因為戰局對伊朗不利。這份提案的內容，和今年六月美伊已經談成的備忘錄相近。

美國總統川普拒絕了伊朗的最新提案——重新開放荷姆茲海峽，換取停火。川普表示，德黑蘭提出這個方案，只是因為戰局對伊朗不利。這份提案的內容，和今年六月美伊已經談成的備忘錄相近。

voice_text: 川普拒絕了伊朗最新的提案。伊朗原本提議重新開放荷姆茲海峽，換取戰爭停火，但川普說，德黑蘭會這樣提，只是因為戰局對他們不利。這份提案的內容，其實和今年六月美伊已經談成的備忘錄很像。
